LESSON: TIME

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade five
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: MEASUREMENTS
Topic 2.6: Time
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Time, part of MEASUREMENTS in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade five MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How can you multiply minutes and seconds by whole numbers?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Time together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: A learner develops experimenting skills as they observe the movement of minute and second

hand on a real clock face involving time in real life situations.

● Learning to learn: A learner develops learning independently as they learn ways of converting time from one unit to

another.

● Digital literacy: A learner interacts with digital devices with assistive technology to play digital games involving time

Values:
• Responsibility: A learner takes care of the resources used when working in pairs or groups to learn about time.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Life skills and values education: A learner acquires essential life skills in time management as they learn about time in

seconds and minutes.

● Citizenship: A learner enhances social cohesion as they estimate seasons of community planting, weeding.

56

Links to other Learning Areas:
● Languages: A learner discusses and shares in pairs or groups reinforcing their communication skills.

● Creative arts: A learner times various field activities during games and sports.

● Science and Technology: A learner states time in relation to rays of light from the sun and changes in the direction of the

shadow.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Analogue and digital clocks, digital watches, stop watches, talking stop watches, taking digital watch, tactile clock faces
